title: coleus stenostachys
intro: Coleus stenostachys, commonly known as the 'Parrot Beak' or 'Rajah Plant', is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Coleus stenostachys include its ability to act as an antispasmodic and a bronchodilator, making it useful for treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
